biotools.summary: IOBR is an R package and accompanying documentation designed to facilitate multi-omics immuno-oncology biological research, specifically focusing on deciphering tumor microenvironment and identifying clinical translation signatures. The package offers a user-friendly pipeline with comprehensive guides for data preprocessing, TME estimation, and interaction analysis.
